identity_note: Matched Modus (Modus Audit LLC / Modus Audit, Inc.), the New York AI-native audit firm at modusalliance.com led by CEO Arush Jain and backed by Lightspeed. Sector (audit) and website match the batch entry. Ruled out unrelated same-name companies such as Modus eDiscovery and Modus Create.

profile.name: Modus
profile.description: AI-native audit and assurance firm for mid-market businesses: it takes majority stakes in the advisory entities of established CPA firms (alternative practice structure) and runs their audits with its own AI agent, Andi. Member CPA firms perform the attest work.
profile.location: New York, NY (corporate roles in New York); partner-firm audit and tax roles in Ohio and New Jersey; site cites five offices and 175+ professionals across the network
profile.founder: Arush Jain (Co-founder & CEO), with co-founders Pranav Pillai and Vinay Kasat (met at the University of Pennsylvania)
profile.funding_detail: $85M total: $5M Seed and $80M Series A, both led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with Comma Capital and Garry Tan participating (announced April 7-8, 2026)
profile.headcount: Corporate team ~13 on LinkedIn (via job-board scrape; Simplify band 11-50); network-wide 175+ professionals per company site, including partner firms
profile.past_completed_deals: One disclosed investment: majority stake in the advisory entity of an unnamed IPA Top 200 accounting firm (>$30M revenue, reportedly Ohio-based, ~175 staff) shortly after the June 2025 launch. Axios reported a target of at least five investments in 2026; no further deals publicly named.

verdict.headline: M&A role open in New York · early-stage CPA roll-up
verdict.detail: Lightspeed-backed with $85M; one firm bought so far and an M&A hire posted on Ashby. Arush Jain (CEO) is the decision-maker.
